instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: But does this feeling happen only with English? Wanting a sign of success more than the real thing, wanting a reward more than reaching your goal. If you have felt this way, you may recognize a little of yourself in the wish to chase rare words. Oh, please don't look at me. Of course, this game alone cannot tell us if people become more interested in opening packs than learning words by heart. Still, it's rare may make you stop and look at a word. You might have passed it by because it seemed useful. That is an interesting way to spark curiosity. It is unexpected to find a gotcha at the entrance, though. What did you learn today? More importantly, ask me what I drew. If you want to say that, you may be a rare word hunter. Before the next card, shall we also check the word's meaning?
